channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: “Jurisprudência Nunes Marques” não deve se manter, diz Gilmar
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes criticized the TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques' decision to suspend the AtlasIntel poll on Flávio Bolsonaro, labeling it 'jurisprudência Nunes Marques' and stating it will not be upheld by the STF, as it violates freedom of expression precedents like ADPF 130. He believes the case will reach the Supreme Court due to disrespect for these precedents, particularly regarding indirect censorship of electoral polls.

item.title: Motta articula com governo aumento do limite do MEI
item.description: Chamber of Deputies President Hugo Motta announced he is negotiating with the federal government to increase the MEI revenue cap from R$81,000 to R$130,000 annually, allowing up to two employees. The proposal, based on PLP 108/2021, is expected to be submitted by the Executive by June 24 for review by a special committee chaired by Any Ortiz with Jorge Goetten as rapporteur. The fiscal impact is estimated at up to R$22.7 billion annually, creating resistance within the economic team despite political support.

item.title: Tarifaço de Trump: governo oscila sobre a melhor estratégia para lidar com os EUA
item.description: The Brazilian government is divided on how to respond to the U.S. tariff threat under the Trump administration, which could impose duties of up to 37.5% on Brazilian exports. While the MDIC advocates for a swift reversal to protect domestic companies, the Foreign Ministry and Treasury prioritize negotiation quality, even if it means delaying talks until after the October Brazilian and November U.S. midterm elections. The lack of a bilateral meeting between Lula and Trump at the G7 has deepened the stalemate, though the government claims to act unanimously in defense of national interest.

item.title: Montadoras tentam barrar volta de isenção de carro elétrico importado que beneficia BYD: decisão será de Lula
item.description: Anfavea is pressuring the federal government to maintain the timetable for reimposing import taxes on electric vehicles, fearing that renewed tax exemptions would favor BYD and destabilize Brazil’s domestic auto sector. The final decision rests with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Vice President Geraldo Alckmin, following a Camex meeting on whether to extend the benefit, which previously applied from August 2025 to January 2026. Automakers cite R$ 140 billion in planned investments through 2030 and oppose additional concessions, while BYD launches its first compact plug-in SUV in Brazil at R$ 149,000.

item.title: Haddad diz lamentar ausência do PSDB nas disputa por governo de SP
item.description: Fernando Haddad expressed regret over the absence of a PSDB candidate in the São Paulo gubernatorial race, saying he had hoped the party would attempt a comeback despite ideological differences. He praised historical PSDB figures like FHC, Mário Covas, and Geraldo Alckmin as ethical references, criticizing the current leadership for being replaced by figures who, he said, do not share values such as truth, democracy, and the fight against violence.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro se inscreve em audiência sobre tarifaço nos EUA
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) has registered to speak at a U.S. International Trade Commission hearing on a proposed 25% tariff on Brazilian imports, recommended by the USTR following an investigation into alleged unfair trade practices. He argues the tariff would benefit the Brazilian government while harming Brazilian exporters, American importers and consumers, and the Brazilian opposition, which he identifies as the main domestic victim. Bolsonaro also opposes any measures targeting Brazil’s Pix payment system, advocating for a negotiated resolution and emphasizing the over-80-year trade partnership between the two countries.

item.title: Mendonça comete “erro crasso” ao saber da delação de Vorcaro, diz Gilmar
item.description: Gilmar Mendes, dean of the Supreme Federal Court, stated that André Mendonça made a "grave error" by speaking with Daniel Vorcaro's lawyer about a selective plea deal, as the law prohibits the rapporteur from participating in such negotiations. Mendes also criticized the use of imprisonment to pressure plea bargains, investigative leaks, and the handling of the Master case, comparing it to Operation Car Wash and stressing the importance of avoiding past mistakes.

item.title: “Vou apresentar todas as reformas em 5 de janeiro”, diz Caiado
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) announced that, if elected, he will send Congress a broad package of reforms on January 5, including tax, labor, administrative, and political changes, with district voting and a single presidential term limit. He criticized the current tax reform for harming liberal professionals, advocated for pension reform due to sustainability concerns, and praised his public security plan based on Goiás’ results, blaming federal leadership for lacking 'moral authority'. Caiado also accused the federal government of undermining Brazil’s industrial competitiveness, citing the 'PT cost' and calling for fiscal balance, lower real interest rates, and a long-term industrial policy.

item.title: Pré-campanha de Flávio teme que Supremo esvazie TSE e o prejudique na disputa com Lula
item.description: Aides and allies of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) fear that recent decisions by the Supreme Federal Court (STF) are disregarding electoral rules and could harm him in the presidential race against Lula (PT). They believe the STF is acting with intent to weaken the TSE’s role and interfere in the 2026 election process.

item.title: PT rechaça ideia de Márcio França de se lançar ao governo de SP
item.description: Leaders of the Workers' Party (PT) rejected former governor Márcio França's (PSB) proposal to run for Governor of São Paulo in 2026, arguing that his candidacy could split the opposition and make it easier for incumbent Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) to secure a runoff. The PT prefers to consolidate a single left-wing candidate to face the right in a potential second round.

item.title: Mortes de PC Farias e Suzana completam 30 anos com processo encerrado e memória em disputa
item.description: The case involving the deaths of PC Farias and Suzana Ramos, which occurred 30 years ago, had its judicial process closed after 22 years, yet remains an enigma in Brazilian politics. PC Farias, treasurer of Fernando Collor's campaign, was a central figure in the corruption scheme that led to the president's impeachment. Despite the case being archived, memory and responsibility for the crimes remain disputed among historians, journalists, and political sectors.

item.title: Projeto do governo sobre aumento do teto do MEI deve ser enviado à Câmara nesta semana, diz Motta
item.description: House Speaker Hugo Motta announced that the Lula government will send a proposal to increase the MEI's annual revenue cap — currently R$81,000 — to the Chamber by this Wednesday (24). The goal is to balance fiscal responsibility with the needs of microentrepreneurs, as competing bills in Congress propose raising the cap to R$140,000 or R$150,000.

item.title: O novo cenário que aproxima Tarcísio da reeleição já no primeiro turno em SP
item.description: The withdrawal of Kim Kataguiri (Missão) and Paulo Serra (PSDB) strengthens Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) as the frontrunner for re-election in São Paulo, with 45.6% of first-round voting intentions according to Paraná Pesquisas, versus 34.1% for Fernando Haddad (PT). Their exit reduces fragmentation in the conservative field, directly benefiting the governor, who is still working to broaden his coalition with nearly ten parties and aims to attract PSDB and Missão. Even in a potential runoff, Tarcísio leads with 51.4% against Haddad’s 37.9%, within the margin of error.

item.title: Caiado diz que anunciará vice antes das convenções de 26 de julho
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) announced he will reveal his vice-presidential running mate before the party's conventions on July 26, speaking at a CNI event in Brasília. He named PSD president Gilberto Kassab as a possible vice-presidential candidate, denied any alliance with Romeu Zema, and highlighted Silvia Abravanel as a 'strong name' for electoral politics—though she clarified her focus remains on running for federal deputy.

item.title: Se o capitalismo reaça tem cloaca, seu nome é Zema: o pombo e o xadrez
item.description: The text criticizes Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and pre-candidate of the Novo party, comparing him to a 'cloaca' of late capitalism due to his reactionary stance, ignorance, and class hatred. Zema advocates revising Bolsa Família to require only men to study to receive the benefit, while exempting women on the grounds of domestic work, revealing sexism and lack of technical basis. Despite being applauded by businessmen who benefited from Lula’s policies, his rhetoric is seen as vulgar, anti-intellectual, and disconnected from Brazil’s low unemployment reality.

item.title: 'Mulheres têm outras atribuições em casa', diz Zema ao anunciar que, se eleito, pretende exigir estudo só dos homens no Bolsa Família
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) stated that, if elected, he would require only male beneficiaries of the Bolsa Família program to complete their studies, arguing that women have 'other responsibilities at home'. He framed the measure as a way to encourage skills development and labor market insertion, while rewarding those who transition to formal employment. The proposal contrasts with current Bolsa Família rules, which mandate school attendance for both boys and girls.

item.title: O parecer da PGR sobre quem deve ser o relator do caso Dark Horse
item.description: The PGR argued that Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça should be appointed as rapporteur for the case investigating payments by banker Daniel Vorcaro to fund the film Dark Horse, a biopic of former President Jair Bolsonaro. The opinion was requested by Minister Alexandre de Moraes following a petition by federal deputy Lindberg Farias (PT-RJ), who alleges links between the film’s financing and Eduardo Bolsonaro’s efforts to push U.S. sanctions against Brazil. Moraes asked STF President Edson Fachin to issue the final decision, noting that Mendonça already rapporteurs the Master Case involving Vorcaro.

item.title: Pesquisa Ipsos/Ipec: governo Lula tem piores avaliações nas áreas econômica e de segurança
item.description: The Ipsos/Ipec poll shows that Lula's government receives its worst ratings in economic and security areas, with 51% disapproval on public spending control and 49% on inflation combat. Despite initiatives like Novo Desenrola Brasil and Brasil Contra o Crime Organizado, ratings remain stable compared to March. Education is the best-rated area, though disapproval (38%) still exceeds approval (35%).

item.title: Lula diz a estudantes que “político honesto” está dentro deles
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva encouraged OBMEP gold medalist students not to abandon politics despite perceptions of corruption, stating that the honest politician they seek lies within themselves. He emphasized the importance of public education, citing expanded university access and the creation of OBMEP during his first term as tools to reveal the potential of low-income students. Lula also criticized Brazil's historical neglect of education and stressed that investment in education is essential for national development.

item.title: CFM reage à regra que exige nota mínima em prova para exercer Medicina
item.description: The Federal Council of Medicine (CFM) rejected the Provisional Measure signed by President Lula that establishes a minimum score on the National High School Exam (Enem) as a requirement for admission to medical schools. The CFM argues the measure is arbitrary, overlooks student diversity, and could worsen the country’s doctor shortage, especially in underserved regions. The council maintains that access to medicine should rely on broader criteria, not solely on standardized test performance.

item.title: O parecer do MPE sobre suspensão da divulgação de pesquisa eleitoral da AtlasIntel
item.description: The Electoral Public Ministry (MPE) opposed the suspension of the AtlasIntel poll on the impact of conversations between Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro on voting intentions, stating that judicial intervention in electoral polls must be exceptional and not justified without evidence of undue influence. The poll, released on May 19, showed a five-point drop in Flávio Bolsonaro's voting intention after the conversations were disclosed, and was suspended by individual order of TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques at the PL's request. The MPE found no irregularities in the questions and noted that addressing politically sensitive topics is natural in electoral research.

item.title: Procuradoria se manifesta contra suspensão de pesquisa que mostrou Flávio Bolsonaro em queda
item.description: The Electoral Prosecutor's Office opposed the suspension of the AtlasIntel poll showing Flávio Bolsonaro down seven points against Lula in a potential runoff. The MP argued there are no grounds to uphold the injunction, stating the Electoral Justice should not act as a curator of poll results, especially when the survey addressed the Master scandal, which is a legitimate subject of public scrutiny. The TSE plenary had begun reviewing the suspension but postponed deliberation after a request for review by Minister Estela Aranha.

item.title: Procuradoria se manifesta contra censura de Kassio a pesquisa que apontou queda de Flávio
item.description: The Electoral General Prosecutor's Office (PGE) opposed the censorship imposed by TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques on an Atlas/Bloomberg poll showing declining support for PL presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro following the 'Dark Horse' case. The PGE stated the poll is valid and that suppressing it violates freedom of expression and the right to information during the electoral process.

item.title: Caiado defende reformas estruturantes para reduzir o ‘Custo Brasil’ em evento da CNI
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), pre-candidate for President, advocated for structural reforms in labor, pensions, and taxation to reduce Brazil's 'Custo Brasil' (which he labeled 'Custo PT') during a CNI event in Brasília. He criticized the fiscal framework as ineffective in controlling public debt (78.6% of GDP in 2025) and accused the Lula government of violating its own fiscal rules. Caiado also emphasized the need for region-specific energy investments, such as biomass in Goiás and wind/solar in the Northeast, advocating for pragmatic, proven solutions.

item.title: O que diz o presidente do PT sobre a permanência de Jaques Wagner na liderança após caso Master
item.description: The national president of the Workers' Party (PT), Edinho Silva, stated that Senator Jaques Wagner's continued leadership in the Senate government bloc will be decided after a dialogue between Wagner and President Lula, following Wagner being targeted in a PF investigation into Banco Master. Edinho reaffirmed the party's trust in Wagner's presumption of innocence and said the case has no connection to the Lula government, emphasizing respect for the autonomy of investigative institutions.

item.title: Zema diz que não exigiria estudo de mulheres no Bolsa Família
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) stated that, if elected president, he would not require education compliance from women in the Bolsa Família program, prioritizing conditions for young and adult men, arguing that women have 'other responsibilities at home'. He proposed a R$ 5,000 bonus for beneficiaries who leave the program after securing formal employment, aiming to reduce dependency on social assistance and promote financial autonomy.

item.title: PGR sugere que Mendonça decida sobre investigação de finaciamento do filme Dark Horse
item.description: Attorney General Paulo Gonet recommended that Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça be appointed rapporteur of the investigation into the alleged financing of the film 'Dark Horse' by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, due to its connection to the 'Master case' already under Mendonça’s supervision. The final decision rests with STF President Luiz Edson Fachin, who may retain, transfer to Mendonça, or randomize the rapporteur assignment. The request was submitted by Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) to examine Flávio Bolsonaro’s role in the film’s funding.

item.title: Com saídas de Kim e Paulo Serra, eleição em SP se polariza entre Tarcísio e Haddad
item.description: The withdrawals of Paulo Serra (PSDB) and Kim Kataguiri (Missão) have reshaped the São Paulo gubernatorial race, polarizing it between Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) and Fernando Haddad (PT). Márcio França (PSB) is considering a new candidacy to force a runoff and weaken Freitas, coordinating with the PT to undermine his lead in polls.

item.title: Cidadania se irrita com líder do PSDB e estuda lançar candidato ao Governo de SP
item.description: The Cidadania party is considering launching its own candidate for the São Paulo gubernatorial race after Paulo Serra, president of the state PSDB, withdrew from challenging Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos). The move reflects dissatisfaction with the PSDB and seeks an alternative amid a lack of opposition consensus.

item.title: Lula será avô novamente: décimo neto do presidente está a caminho
item.description: Lula will become a grandfather again, as his son Luís Cláudio Lula da Silva is expecting a child with his fiancée, Tamyres Dutra, a pedagogue. The president’s tenth grandchild is on the way, bringing his total to ten grandchildren and one great-granddaughter. Lula has five children: four sons and one daughter, Lurian.

item.title: Se eleito, Caiado diz que enviará projeto de reforma do STF ao Congresso
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, PSD's pre-candidate for Presidency, stated that if elected, he will send to Congress on the first day of his mandate a package of reforms, including changes to the STF with conditions for the appointment and swearing-in of ministers. He also mentioned administrative, political (with district voting), educational, labor, and tax reforms, plus a revision of the 2017 labor reform, which he called 'mutilated'.

item.title: MPE se manifesta contra suspensão de pesquisa AtlasIntel pelo TSE
item.description: The Electoral Public Ministry (MPE) opposed the suspension of the AtlasIntel poll ordered by TSE Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, recommending full dismissal of the PL's request. The MPE argued that judicial intervention in polls should only occur in exceptional cases with objective proof of bias, not based on potential electoral consequences. It noted that questions on politically relevant facts—such as the leaked calls between Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro—are standard market practice, already used by Datafolha, Quaest, and Ideia in May and June 2026.

item.title: PF mapeia contatos de Daniel Vorcaro com núcleos do governo e da oposição em Brasília
item.description: The Federal Police mapped contacts of Daniel Vorcaro, former controller of Banco Master, with federal government and opposition figures in Brasília, including meetings with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. Data from Operation Compliance Zero reveals alleged political outreach efforts by Vorcaro, broadening the scope of investigations into his activities in the capital.

item.title: PGR defende validade de pesquisa que mediu efeitos de caso Master sobre Flávio Bolsonaro e contraria Nunes Marques
item.description: The Electoral Attorney General's Office (PGE) defended the validity of an AtlasIntel poll that measured the impact of the Banco Master case on Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's image and voting intentions, rejecting a lawsuit by the Liberal Party (PL) alleging methodological bias. The PGE argued that the Electoral Justice should not interfere in the choice of topics by polling institutes, except in cases of evident fraud, and noted that voting intention questions were asked before those related to the Banco Master case, weakening the claim of result contamination. The opinion was submitted to the TSE, where Minister Nunes Marques is the rapporteur.

item.title: Lula dizer que ‘nunca foi esquerdista’ muda o quê, na eleição, nas Américas e no mundo?
item.description: Lula's claim that he 'was never a leftist' during the G7 reflects an electoral strategy to appease global capital and project moderation amid rising right-wing influence across South America. This rhetoric, echoing his 2003 statements, seeks to avoid ideological labels while retaining core support, but operates in a region marked by growing polarization, with narrow right-wing victories in Colombia and Peru. The remark reveals a political calculation to balance domestic bases and external pressures in a global landscape shaped by figures like Trump and Putin.

item.title: Lula “parece parceiro de grupos narcoterroristas”, diz Flávio
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) accused President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) of appearing to be a partner of narcoterrorist groups, claiming the president makes gestures toward marginals and shows sympathy with organized crime. Flávio stated that, if elected, he would adopt a hardline stance against crime. The remarks were made on Monday, the 22nd.

item.title: Fundador do Prerrogativas aceita convite do PT e vai comandar campanha de Lula em São Paulo
item.description: Lawyer Marco Aurélio de Carvalho, founder of the Prerrogativas group, accepted the PT's invitation to coordinate Lula's campaign in São Paulo. His responsibilities will include liaising with Fernando Haddad's gubernatorial campaign, mobilizing grassroots support, overseeing campaign material production and distribution, and managing the president's agenda in the state. The appointment underscores the PT's strategic focus on winning in São Paulo, where it aims to reverse years of electoral setbacks.

item.title: Casos de Flávio e Wagner são ‘extremamente diferentes’, diz presidente do PT
item.description: PT President Edinho Silva stated that the cases involving Flávio Bolsonaro and Jaques Wagner with Daniel Vorcaro and Banco Master are 'extremely different'. He said there is no link between Wagner and the Lula government, contrasting it with audio evidence showing Flávio requesting money from Vorcaro to finance the film Dark Horse, with 60 million reais transferred abroad.

item.title: A reação de Michelle Bolsonaro à declaração de Ciro Gomes de que não vai apoiar Flávio
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro criticized Ciro Gomes after he stated he would not support Flávio Bolsonaro for president, despite having PL backing in Ceará. She shared a video by Clayton Prudêncio accusing Ciro of making deals with 'the right negotiating with Satan' and promised to speak more directly soon. Michelle had previously tried to break the PL-Ciro alliance in Ceará but was overruled by Flávio, Carlos, and Eduardo Bolsonaro, deepening her estrangement from Flávio's presidential campaign.

item.title: A reação de Michelle à declaração de Ciro Gomes de que Lula e Bolsonaro são iguais
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro harshly criticized Ciro Gomes after he stated in a VEJA interview that Lula and Bolsonaro are 'equal' and said he would not support Flávio Bolsonaro for president. She argued her opposition to Ciro in Ceará was justified due to spurious alliances and announced she will soon release a video explaining the situation. Michelle had previously tried to block the PL-Ciro alliance in Ceará last year but was overruled by Bolsonaro’s sons, straining her relationship with Flávio.

item.title: CBF divulga tabela das rodadas 19 a 24 do Brasileirão; quatro jogos acontecem durante a Copa
item.description: The CBF released the detailed schedule for rounds 19 to 24 of the Brasileirão Série A, set between July 16 and August 9. Four matches will take place before the 2026 World Cup final, including Botafogo vs Santos, Vitória vs Vasco, and Mirassol vs Grêmio on July 16 — three days prior to the World Cup final. The fixture features key relegation and Libertadores battles, with some venues still to be confirmed.

item.title: Procuradoria é contra suspensão por Nunes Marques de pesquisa que mostrou queda de intenção de votos de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Electoral General Prosecutor's Office urged the TSE to overturn Minister Kassio Nunes Marques' individual decision suspending an AtlasIntel poll showing a five-point drop in Flávio Bolsonaro's voting intentions after an audio leak. The PGE stated there is no evidence of poll manipulation and that judicial intervention should be minimal, only addressing objectively proven breaches of impartiality, which were not demonstrated here. The trial was postponed at the request of Minister Estela Aranha for further review.

item.title: Brasil vai passar por “mexicanização” se PT continuar, diz Caiado
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) warned that Brazil will undergo a 'Mexicanization' if the Workers' Party remains in power, claiming the formal economy will be overrun by crime. He made the statement at the 'Brazil 2050: Industry in the Presidential Candidates' Agenda' event, organized by the CNI in Brasília, stating that citizens will have no recourse against threats that daily affect lives and destabilize the economy.

item.title: Justiça nega pedido de Renan Santos para remover publicações sobre acusação de estupro
item.description: São Paulo's Justice denied the request by presidential pre-candidate Renan Santos to remove social media posts about a 2021 police report accusing him of rape and domestic violence. The court ruled that content removal is an exceptional measure, noted the limited privacy rights of public figures, and confirmed the police report's authenticity. The decision was upheld on appeal by the 10th Private Law Chamber of TJ-SP.

item.title: Caiado: Se Brasil continuar com PT, vai virar 'mexicanização', com economia invadida pelo crime
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, PSD's pre-candidate for the Brazilian presidency, warned that if Brazil does not effectively combat organized crime — especially at its borders — the country will undergo a process of 'Mexicanization', with the economy being infiltrated by criminal groups.

item.title: Lula diz que Eduardo Paes esqueceu de IF da Cidade de Deus
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva criticized the delay in constructing the Federal Institute of Cidade de Deus, accusing former mayor Eduardo Paes of forgetting to release the promised building from 2024. Lula announced R$ 702.9 million for favela urbanization in Rio and cited other stalled projects, such as the IF of Complexo do Alemão, due to issues like rocks on the site and lack of planning. He urged faster execution, emphasizing the need for better coordination between federal, state, and municipal governments.

item.title: Temor de impacto na campanha de Lula pressiona Jaques Wagner a deixar liderança do governo no Senado
item.description: Jaques Wagner, the government leader in the Senate, faces pressure to resign due to concerns that his ties to the Banco Master case could harm Lula’s re-election campaign. The PT leadership and the Planalto Palace advocate for his removal to protect Lula’s image, which currently holds a slim lead over Flávio Bolsonaro in polls. Despite Wagner’s resistance, the decision will be made in a meeting with Lula on Wednesday, while campaign coordinators downplay the PF operation’s impact, noting it did not mobilize public attention as much as the World Cup.

item.title: TSE recebe 135 representações de pré-campanhas em 2026, quatro vezes mais do que em 2022
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) received 135 representations of premature campaigning in 2026, four times more than in the same period of 2022. The surge is driven by actions from the PT and PL, primarily involving pre-campaigns of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, with frequent use of artificial intelligence in content deemed disinformation or negative electoral propaganda, including AI-generated videos linking the senator to criminal groups or depicting the PT as a target of attacks.

item.title: Couto tem a missão “de moralizar a política do Rio”, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula stated that Ricardo Couto, the interim governor of Rio de Janeiro, has the mission to 'moralize politics' and 'end corruption' in the state. He said it was destiny that brought Couto to this task, which he considers noble.

item.title: Acordo de terras-raras com EUA é “papagaiada” de Caiado, diz Delúbio
item.description: Delúbio Soares, former PT treasurer, criticized Ronaldo Caiado’s March 2026 rare earths agreement with the U.S., calling it a 'papagaiada' and stating the memorandum lacks legal validity since Brazil’s subsurface is under federal jurisdiction. He accused Caiado of using the document as propaganda to boost his presidential pre-candidacy, noting that Brazil’s only active rare earths mine in Minaçu, Goiás, was sold to USA Rare Earth for $2.8 billion in April 2026.
